options.reason: Two categorical outcome columns encode the same angiographic disease judgement at different granularity (num 0-4 severity, heart_disease_binary its 0/1 recoding), so per the joint-outcome rule both are targets of one multilabel model rather than treating the coarser level as leakage; all remaining columns are pre-diagnostic clinical/exercise-test measurements usable as features, and there is no identifier, group or chronology column.
options.title: multilabel
